scope: Six primary-source deep reads; local P006 mechanism and training evidence. No benchmark trajectory download, model download, GPU, training, paid teacher, heldout access, or test files.

sources.title: SWE-Tester: Training Open-Source LLMs for Issue Reproduction in Real-World Repositories
sources.resource_observation: Repository lists data_preparation, torchtune_train, eval and retrieval. HF training dataset page is accessible with four subsets; no bulk data fetched.
sources.license: Paper CC BY 4.0; A.11 states upstream repositories MIT/Apache/BSD. Repository homepage and HF page do not expose an unambiguous code/aggregate-data license; raw-file/API reads failed.
sources.protocol_caution: Qwen rows in the main results and oracle-retrieval appendix coincide. Original results/configs were not fetched to resolve this ambiguity. Gemma-3 is not Gemma-4; LoRA ablation is on Qwen with oracle retrieval.

sources.title: Can Old Tests Do New Tricks for Resolving SWE Issues?
sources.resource_observation: README identifies the paper artifact, pipeline implementation and execution-cost caveat. Did not open bundled benchmark case results or run the pipeline.
sources.license: Paper v2 CC BY 4.0; author repository Apache-2.0. Upstream benchmark/code licenses remain separate.
sources.version_caution: Initially read v1 (2025-10-21, title When Old Meets New), then verified v2 and used v2 results. Do not confuse unrelated NeuraCerebra-AI/testprune skill with this paper. API-dollar overhead excludes execution wall time.

sources.title: From Plan to Action: How Well Do Agents Follow the Plan?
sources.resource_observation: Paper references original Zenodo DOI; latest metadata redirects to v3, published 2026-08-21, plan-to-action.7z 1.3 GB, MD5 40379cde208a6de64f014636b882426b. Metadata only, archive not downloaded or inspected.
sources.license: Paper CC BY 4.0. Zenodo rendered License field has no value; code/data license not established.
sources.protocol_caution: Use arXiv v3 sample count, not older abstract retained on IBM's 2026-10-12 page. SWE-bench Pro analysis is a success-selected subset. Paper states default runtime settings and refers to archive; no same-300-second claim supported.

sources.title: Kimi-Dev: Agentless Training as Skill Prior for SWE-Agents
sources.resource_observation: Author inference repository and model entry visible; full mid-training corpus availability not established. No weights or training trajectories fetched.
sources.license: Paper CC BY 4.0. LICENSE.md says model is MIT subject to Qwen LICENSE AGREEMENT. This does not establish licenses of all source datasets.
sources.protocol_caution: Section 4.2 contains contradictory wording 'is outperformed' followed by a claim of stronger RL prior; do not quote that sentence as a comparative result. Strong initialization includes large mid-training and RL. Phase-cutoff analysis explicitly mixes reflection with testing.

sources.title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
sources.resource_observation: Repository URL comes from paper. GitHub, raw README/LICENSE and API reads returned access errors in this session; repository release completeness and license not verified.
sources.license: Paper CC BY 4.0; code/checkpoint/data license unverified.
sources.protocol_caution: Merged-before-quantization LoRA-QAD differs from fixed CT base plus unmerged adapter. No fixed Gemma CT / NF4 transfer result. Memory and hardware observations are not L4 capacity estimates.

sources.title: Agent Skills Can Be Harmful: An Empirical Study of Skill-Induced Failures in LLM Agents
sources.resource_observation: No author code/data URL verified. Search hits with SkillTriage name were unrelated and not treated as the artifact.
sources.license: Paper CC BY 4.0; code/data license not established.
sources.protocol_caution: Potential comparison-pair count is not independent task count or executed-run denominator. Negative-case mining and subjective attribution do not estimate population harm rate or establish Gemma skill effects.

access_notes: Web supplied primary paper/repository/metadata content. A one-off standard-library request for four public metadata endpoints failed DNS under the local sandbox; no escalation or large download was attempted. Mutable repository pages were inspected as of retrieval date; commit-level reproducibility was not established.
